_metadata.description: Requirements derived from the P0 operational targets: the coverage grid, the setpoint, trust, the ranked surface, and the open-loop self-report.

requirements.description: Join each control layer's authored reliability space against the fleet's live surface into a typed cell grid, reporting NOW / IN-REACH / MISSING per cell with per-projection denominator-confidence. Spaces are read live from their owners and never cached; a cell absent from a live join keeps its authored status rather than being fabricated as MISSING.
requirements.title: Live cell grid

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P0-001] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Parse the checked-in setpoint into typed bars and validate it: every NOW cell has a bar, no bar equals the reading it was authored against, every honesty flag is derived rather than hand-set, and every changed bar carries a decision reference. An unparseable setpoint fails loudly instead of reporting zero targets as zero problems. No API path may write the setpoint.
requirements.title: Setpoint read and integrity

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P0-002] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Attach a closed-vocabulary trust verdict to every reading (VALID, GHOST, SATURATED, SHELVED, UNIT_MISMATCH, UNAVAILABLE, UNTRUSTED). Only VALID contributes to an aggregate, every trust number is reported as a distribution over checked readings over total readings, and an untrusted reading routes to the instrument's owner rather than becoming plant work.
requirements.title: Trust-qualified readings

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P0-003] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Merge out-of-band readings, untrusted readings, open-loop cells, coverage drift and source unavailability into a single ranked surface a member reads with one call. Sources are named and independently degradable, and ranking honours cascade order — sensor-channel integrity first — and states that it is doing so.
requirements.title: One ranked error surface

validation.notes: Scaffolded stub: replace with a test-typed validation (ref + [REQ:IFM-P0-004] tag) once the behavior exists.

requirements.description: Count and date every MISSING cell, including this scenario's own blind spots, so an honest hole is visible and ageing rather than silent. The instrumentation roadmap becomes the computed open-loop set rather than a hand-maintained list that can disagree with the grid beside it.
requirements.title: Open-loop self-report
